Combat weapon systems are described as concealable; no quantified detection or combat bonus is printed.

blockingFindings.issue: Source does not establish all physical weapon mount hardware counts, gunner-to-barrel mapping or firing arcs. Never equate attack rows, batteries, payload or turret imagery with an exhaustive physical blueprint.
Cabin printed statblock contains no Ranged, Atk Options, Hyperdrive, or battery/weapon block. These are source-silent, not a license to manufacture mounts.

configurationAndRuleFindings.finding: Cabin detaches from main CL 9 Seltiss-2 hull and flies independently as the explicitly printed CL 3 Huge transport.
No ranged weapon row or hyperdrive line is printed for the detachable cabin; do not invent armament or infer a drive.
